This file provides guidance to Coding Agent when working with code in this repository.

## What is PegaInfer

Pure Rust + CUDA LLM inference engine. No PyTorch, no frameworks. OpenAI-compatible `/v1/completions` API.

**Supported models:**

Every model line is behind a cargo feature; only `qwen3` is a default feature, so the stock build is pure Rust + CUDA with no Python.

| Model | Crate | Feature flag | Architecture |
|-------|-------|-------------|-------------|
| Qwen3-4B / 8B | `pegainfer-qwen3` | `qwen3` (default) | Full attention, TP support |
| Qwen3.5-4B / 9B / 27B · Qwen3.8-27B | `pegainfer-qwen35` | `--features qwen35` (needs build-time Python + Triton) | Hybrid Gated DeltaNet + full attention. Qwen3.8 shares the line: same `model_type`, same text geometry — see `docs/models/qwen35/support-qwen38.md` |
| DeepSeek-V2-Lite | `pegainfer-deepseek-v2-lite` | `--features deepseek-v2-lite` | MoE + EP, 2-GPU |
| Gemma 4 | `pegainfer-gemma4` | `--features gemma4` | Sliding-window + global full attention, dense sizes at TP2 (one rank per device), batched decode, opt-in chunked prefill (single rank only) |
| Kimi-K2 | `pegainfer-kimi-k2` | `--features kimi-k2` | MLA + MoE + Marlin INT4, 8-GPU EP |
| GLM5.2 | `pegainfer-glm52` | `--features glm52` | MLA + MoE + FP8, 8-GPU EP (bring-up) |
| Kimi-K3 | `pegainfer-k3` | `--features k3` | Hybrid KDA + MLA, latent MoE + MXFP4, EP (bring-up — single-rank decode wired) |

## Build & Run

**Always use `--release`** — debug builds are extremely slow for GPU/CUDA and will timeout.

When developing with Docker, use `docker/Dockerfile.dev` and `docker/dev.sh` as described in `docker/README.md`.

```bash
# Qwen3 (default feature, no Python anywhere in the build)
cargo run --release -- --model-path models/Qwen3-4B

# Feature-gated models
cargo run --release --features qwen35 -- --model-path models/Qwen3.5-4B
cargo run --release --features kimi-k2 -- --model-path models/Kimi-K2
cargo run --release --features deepseek-v2-lite -- --model-path models/DeepSeek-V2-Lite
cargo run --release --features glm52 -- --model-path models/GLM5.2
```

**Key env vars:**
- `PEGAINFER_CUDA_SM` — GPU SM target override when `nvidia-smi` unavailable (e.g. `120` or `120,80`)
- `PEGAINFER_TRITON_PYTHON` — Python with Triton for `qwen35` build-time AOT kernel generation (falls back to `.venv/bin/python`, then `python3`, then `python`)
- `PEGAINFER_TILELANG_PYTHON` — Python with TileLang for the `glm52` sparse-MLA build-time AOT (sm_90a targets only)
- `PEGAINFER_NCCL_ROOT` — NCCL root (>= 2.30.4) for DeepEP shim (`moe` feature)
- `PEGAINFER_FLASHINFER_INCLUDE` — FlashInfer include dir override
- `PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH` — override test model path (default: `models/Qwen3-4B`)
- `PEGAINFER_BUILD_TIMING=1` — print per-phase build timings (nvcc, Triton AOT, etc.)
- `PEGAINFER_NVCC_JOBS` — override parallel nvcc job count
- `PEGAINFER_GEMM_LT_CACHE` — opt-in cross-process cublasLt algo store: `<file>` carries the winners `gemm_lt_tune` timed in an earlier boot instead of re-timing them (Qwen3-4B on one sm_89 card: warm ready ~1965 → ~1312 ms, paired 5/5). Append-only text, created if absent, safe to share between processes and machines and safe to delete; each record carries GPU, CUDA runtime/driver/cublasLt version, shape and workspace cap, so anything that does not match is a miss and re-tunes (a driver update that keeps the same CUDA level is not distinguished — delete the file to force a re-tune). Unset = tune on every boot; Qwen3's `--batch-invariant` pins the heuristic instead and never reads it
- `PEGAINFER_GLOBAL_ATTN` — gemma4 global-attention kernel and pool format: unset/`off` = the incumbent kernel on the split K|V pool (byte-identical serving); `tilelang` = the generated kernel on the same pool; `tilelang640` = the generated kernel on a folded pool whose rows hold K only where the rotation touches it and fold K's norm weight into the query, 640 columns per token per head instead of 1024. Both generated states also read the sliding family's prompt rows through a generated windowed prefill and its pure-decode rows through a generated windowed split-KV kernel, project Q|K|V and gate|up with one GEMM each where the split state issues one per projection (the fused shape may round differently), need a build that carries the kernels, and report the global pool's bytes at start-up
- `PEGAINFER_KV_FP8` — gemma4 opt-in fp8 KV: `local` stores the sliding family's K/V as e4m3 at scale 1.0 (lossy; halves the local pool; refuses an enabled prefix cache; unset = byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_PREFIX_CACHE` — gemma4 opt-in conversation prefix cache: `K` entries of captured prompt state resume multi-turn prompts (pre-allocated page budget; unset = off, byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_ADMIT_COALESCE_MS` — gemma4 opt-in admission coalesce door: `N` ms in `1..=2000` (`off`/`0`/unset = admit on sight), holds arrivals that would invade a live decode batch so a window's arrivals land as one admission burst; refuses the async prefill lane; merging into one mixed step needs the chunked walk or a sub-budget prompt
- `PEGAINFER_ASYNC_PREFILL` — gemma4 opt-in overlap lane: `green:NN` prefills live-batch admissions on an SM-capped stream to protect decode tails (`shared` for comparison; unset = off; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` — gemma4 opt-in chunked walk: a mixed admission computes at most `N` prompt rows per step (`64 <= N <` the serving ceiling; unset = whole-prompt steps; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_GATHER_ROWS` / `PEGAINFER_MIX_MAX_PROMPTS` — gemma4 admission gather: how many prompt rows and how many prompts one mixed step may absorb (`1..=` the serving ceiling and `1..=` the decode slots; defaults gather only short bursts). Raising them lets a burst ride one step, which trades the median time to first token for the p99 tail and the wide-batch decode step; bad values refuse to start
- `PEGAINFER_MAX_CONTEXT` — gemma4 serving ceiling raise (default 8192, up to the checkpoint's 262144; a raise past the default needs `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` and refuses the async lane)
- `PEGAINFER_DECODE_SLOTS` — gemma4 decode slots (1..16, default 16): global KV budget = slots x ceiling, trade concurrency for context
- `GLM52_DECODE_SLOTS` / `GLM52_MTP_DRAFTS` — glm52 runtime profile: decode slots per rank (default 8, ceiling 32) and MTP draft span (default 5); `slots x (1+drafts)` must fit the 96-row step (validated at launch; MTP only). Throughput ceiling profile: `32` / `2`.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP` — k3 opt-in context-parallel prefill lane: CP width, must equal the process's local rank count (on a fleet each process runs its own gang; remote ranks pad). Mutually exclusive with the dspark draft lane.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP_MIN` — k3 CP admission floor in prompt tokens (default 2048; measured crossover ~1k). Prompts below it, or too long for one chunk step per rank (M0), prefill locally.

## Tests

```bash
# Unit tests (~9s)
cargo test --release --workspace --lib

# Lines gated on their own kernel feature need it named to run their unit tests.
# The K3 command also names the kernels crate, whose K3 tests ride the same
# feature:
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-k3 -p pegainfer-kernels --features k3 --lib
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-glm52 --features glm52 --lib

# Accuracy and integration tests — require GPU + model weights
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen3 --test hf_golden_gate
PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH=models/Qwen3.5-4B cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen35 --features qwen35 --test hf_golden_gate
PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH=models/Qwen3.5-4B cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen35 --features qwen35 --test e2e_scheduler

# Single test (filter by name)
cargo test --release --workspace --lib prefix_cache -- --nocapture
```

Qwen accuracy gates compare logits against stored HF golden fixtures. Qwen3.5 exact-text JSON baselines are retired; keep `e2e_scheduler` for scheduler liveness and request-flow coverage.

## Architecture

```
HTTP Request → vLLM frontend → EngineHandle → per-model scheduler/executor → TokenEvent
                                               │
              ┌──────────┬─────────────┬───────┼───────────┬──────────┐
              │          │             │       │           │          │
        pegainfer-  pegainfer-   pegainfer-  pegainfer-  pegainfer-  ...
        qwen3       qwen35       dsv2-lite   kimi-k2     glm52
      (full attn) (linear+full) (MoE+EP)   (MLA+MoE)  (MLA+MoE+FP8)
              │          │             │       │           │          │
              └──────────┴─────────────┴───────┼───────────┴──────────┘
                                               │
                          pegainfer-core runtime + pegainfer-kernels
                                               │
                               ┌───────────────┼───────────────┐
                               │               │               │
                       CUDA / cuBLAS    Triton AOT      FlashInfer
                                                    (sampling, attention,
                                                     norm, MLA decode)
```

**Key abstractions:**

tools.name: Agent
tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

prompt.description: The task for the agent to perform

subagent_type.description: The type of specialized agent to use for this task

model.description: Optional model override for this agent. Takes precedence over the agent definition's model frontmatter and the configured default subagent model. If omitted, uses the agent definition's model, else the default (inherits from the parent unless a default subagent model is configured). Ignored for subagent_type: "fork" — forks always inherit the parent model.

effort.description: Reasoning effort for this agent. Set this ONLY when the user, or instructions such as CLAUDE.md or a skill, explicitly ask that this agent or delegated work run at a specific effort level, never on your own judgment; otherwise omit it and the agent runs at its usual effort. Ignored for subagent_type: "fork": a fork runs at your own effort.

run_in_background.description: Agents run in the background by default; you will be notified when one completes. Set to false only when your very next action depends on this agent's result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise leave it in the background so the user can hand you other work.

isolation.description: Isolation mode. "worktree" creates a temporary git worktree so the agent works on an isolated copy of the repo. "remote" launches the agent in a remote cloud environment (always runs in background; availability is gated).

tools.name: Bash
tools.description:
Executes a bash command and returns its output.

- `cd` carries to the next call only in the main session, if the command succeeds and ends inside the working directories. Outside them the shell returns to the start folder; otherwise it stays where it was. Prefer absolute paths — `cd` in a compound command can trigger a permission prompt. Shell state (env vars, functions) does not persist; the shell is initialized from the user's profile.
- IMPORTANT: Avoid using this tool to run `find`, `grep`, `cat`, `head`, `tail`, `sed`, `awk`, or `echo` commands, unless explicitly instructed or after you have verified that a dedicated tool cannot accomplish your task. Instead, use the appropriate dedicated tool as this will provide a much better experience for the user.
- Command output is displayed to you, not reliably to the user.
- `timeout` is in milliseconds: default 120000, max 600000 for a foreground command.
- `run_in_background` runs the command detached: it keeps running across turns and re-invokes you when it exits. With it, `timeout` is how long the command may run in the background (default 600000, max 7200000); at that limit it is stopped and you are re-invoked. No `&` needed. Foreground `sleep` is blocked; use Monitor with an until-loop to wait on a condition.

# Git
- Interactive flags (`-i`, e.g. `git rebase -i`, `git add -i`) are not supported in this environment.
- Use the `gh` CLI for GitHub operations (PRs, issues, API).
- GitHub notifies the owner of any `@name` written in a PR, issue, or comment. Write a bare `@name` only for a real login you mean to notify. Put roles, placeholders, and code (`@human`, `@reviewer`, `@types/node`) in backticks or drop the `@`, even when copied from project files.
- Commit or push only when the user asks. If on the default branch, branch first.
- End git commit messages and PR bodies with the attribution lines given in the conversation's system-reminder, when one is present.

description.description:
Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice. Never use words like "complex" or "risk" in the description - just describe what it does.

Say what the command does in plain words: do not echo the command's text, its flags, or file paths - the user reads this description, often without seeing the command.

For simple commands (git, npm, standard CLI tools), keep it brief (5-10 words):
- ls → "List files in current directory"
- git status → "Show working tree status"
- npm install → "Install package dependencies"

For commands that are harder to parse at a glance (piped commands, obscure flags, etc.), add enough context to clarify what it does:
- find . -name "*.tmp" -exec rm {} \; → "Find and delete all .tmp files recursively"
- git reset --hard origin/main → "Discard all local changes and match remote main"
- curl -s url | jq '.data[]' → "Fetch JSON from URL and extract data array elements"

- You must Read the file in this conversation before editing, or the call will fail.
- `old_string` must match the file exactly, including indentation, and be unique — the edit fails otherwise. Strip the Read line prefix (line number + tab) before matching.
- `replace_all: true` replaces every occurrence instead.

tools.description:
Content search built on ripgrep. Prefer this over `grep`/`rg` via Bash — results integrate with the permission UI and file links.

- Full regex syntax (e.g. "log.*Error", "function\s+\w+"). Ripgrep, not grep — escape literal braces (`interface\{\}`).
- Filter with `glob` (e.g. "**/*.tsx") or `type` (e.g. "js", "py", "rust").
- `output_mode`: "content" (matching lines), "files_with_matches" (paths only, default), or "count".
- `multiline: true` for patterns that span lines.

pattern.description: The regular expression pattern to search for in file contents

output_mode.description: Output mode: "content" shows matching lines (supports -A/-B/-C context, -n line numbers, head_limit), "files_with_matches" shows file paths (supports head_limit), "count" shows match counts (supports head_limit). Defaults to "files_with_matches".

-B.description: Number of lines to show before each match (rg -B). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-A.description: Number of lines to show after each match (rg -A). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise.

-n.description: Show line numbers in output (rg -n). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to true.

-o.description: Print only the matched (non-empty) parts of each matching line, one match per output line (rg -o / --only-matching). Requires output_mode: "content", ignored otherwise. Defaults to false.

Works across all output modes: content (limits output lines), files_with_matches (limits file paths), count (limits count entries). Defaults to 250 when unspecified. Pass 0 for unlimited (use sparingly — large result sets waste context).

offset.description: Skip first N lines/entries before applying head_limit, equivalent to "| tail -n +N | head -N". Works across all output modes. Defaults to 0.

multiline.description: Enable multiline mode where . matches newlines and patterns can span lines (rg -U --multiline-dotall). Default: false.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

delaySeconds.description: Seconds from now to wake up. Clamped to [60, 3600] by the runtime. Required unless `stop` is true.

reason.description: One short sentence explaining the chosen delay. Goes to telemetry and is shown to the user. Be specific. Required unless `stop` is true.

prompt.description: The /loop input to fire on wake-up. Pass the same /loop input verbatim each turn so the next firing re-enters the skill and continues the loop. For autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` instead (the dynamic-pacing variant, not the CronCreate-mode `<<autonomous-loop>>`). Required unless `stop` is true.

stop.description: Set to true to end the dynamic loop immediately instead of scheduling another wakeup. When true, all other fields are ignored and no further wakeups fire.

noop.description: true = nothing changed (you checked and there is nothing to report). false = something happened worth keeping (edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, surfaced a finding). Consecutive noop:true ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak. Required unless `stop` is true.

tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>

This file provides guidance to Coding Agent when working with code in this repository.

## What is PegaInfer

Pure Rust + CUDA LLM inference engine. No PyTorch, no frameworks. OpenAI-compatible `/v1/completions` API.

**Supported models:**

Every model line is behind a cargo feature; only `qwen3` is a default feature, so the stock build is pure Rust + CUDA with no Python.

| Model | Crate | Feature flag | Architecture |
|-------|-------|-------------|-------------|
| Qwen3-4B / 8B | `pegainfer-qwen3` | `qwen3` (default) | Full attention, TP support |
| Qwen3.5-4B / 9B / 27B · Qwen3.8-27B | `pegainfer-qwen35` | `--features qwen35` (needs build-time Python + Triton) | Hybrid Gated DeltaNet + full attention. Qwen3.8 shares the line: same `model_type`, same text geometry — see `docs/models/qwen35/support-qwen38.md` |
| DeepSeek-V2-Lite | `pegainfer-deepseek-v2-lite` | `--features deepseek-v2-lite` | MoE + EP, 2-GPU |
| Gemma 4 | `pegainfer-gemma4` | `--features gemma4` | Sliding-window + global full attention, dense sizes at TP2 (one rank per device), batched decode, opt-in chunked prefill (single rank only) |
| Kimi-K2 | `pegainfer-kimi-k2` | `--features kimi-k2` | MLA + MoE + Marlin INT4, 8-GPU EP |
| GLM5.2 | `pegainfer-glm52` | `--features glm52` | MLA + MoE + FP8, 8-GPU EP (bring-up) |
| Kimi-K3 | `pegainfer-k3` | `--features k3` | Hybrid KDA + MLA, latent MoE + MXFP4, EP (bring-up — single-rank decode wired) |

## Build & Run

**Always use `--release`** — debug builds are extremely slow for GPU/CUDA and will timeout.

When developing with Docker, use `docker/Dockerfile.dev` and `docker/dev.sh` as described in `docker/README.md`.

```bash
# Qwen3 (default feature, no Python anywhere in the build)
cargo run --release -- --model-path models/Qwen3-4B

# Feature-gated models
cargo run --release --features qwen35 -- --model-path models/Qwen3.5-4B
cargo run --release --features kimi-k2 -- --model-path models/Kimi-K2
cargo run --release --features deepseek-v2-lite -- --model-path models/DeepSeek-V2-Lite
cargo run --release --features glm52 -- --model-path models/GLM5.2
```

**Key env vars:**
- `PEGAINFER_CUDA_SM` — GPU SM target override when `nvidia-smi` unavailable (e.g. `120` or `120,80`)
- `PEGAINFER_TRITON_PYTHON` — Python with Triton for `qwen35` build-time AOT kernel generation (falls back to `.venv/bin/python`, then `python3`, then `python`)
- `PEGAINFER_TILELANG_PYTHON` — Python with TileLang for the `glm52` sparse-MLA build-time AOT (sm_90a targets only)
- `PEGAINFER_NCCL_ROOT` — NCCL root (>= 2.30.4) for DeepEP shim (`moe` feature)
- `PEGAINFER_FLASHINFER_INCLUDE` — FlashInfer include dir override
- `PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH` — override test model path (default: `models/Qwen3-4B`)
- `PEGAINFER_BUILD_TIMING=1` — print per-phase build timings (nvcc, Triton AOT, etc.)
- `PEGAINFER_NVCC_JOBS` — override parallel nvcc job count
- `PEGAINFER_GEMM_LT_CACHE` — opt-in cross-process cublasLt algo store: `<file>` carries the winners `gemm_lt_tune` timed in an earlier boot instead of re-timing them (Qwen3-4B on one sm_89 card: warm ready ~1965 → ~1312 ms, paired 5/5). Append-only text, created if absent, safe to share between processes and machines and safe to delete; each record carries GPU, CUDA runtime/driver/cublasLt version, shape and workspace cap, so anything that does not match is a miss and re-tunes (a driver update that keeps the same CUDA level is not distinguished — delete the file to force a re-tune). Unset = tune on every boot; Qwen3's `--batch-invariant` pins the heuristic instead and never reads it
- `PEGAINFER_GLOBAL_ATTN` — gemma4 global-attention kernel and pool format: unset/`off` = the incumbent kernel on the split K|V pool (byte-identical serving); `tilelang` = the generated kernel on the same pool; `tilelang640` = the generated kernel on a folded pool whose rows hold K only where the rotation touches it and fold K's norm weight into the query, 640 columns per token per head instead of 1024. Both generated states also read the sliding family's prompt rows through a generated windowed prefill and its pure-decode rows through a generated windowed split-KV kernel, project Q|K|V and gate|up with one GEMM each where the split state issues one per projection (the fused shape may round differently), need a build that carries the kernels, and report the global pool's bytes at start-up
- `PEGAINFER_KV_FP8` — gemma4 opt-in fp8 KV: `local` stores the sliding family's K/V as e4m3 at scale 1.0 (lossy; halves the local pool; refuses an enabled prefix cache; unset = byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_PREFIX_CACHE` — gemma4 opt-in conversation prefix cache: `K` entries of captured prompt state resume multi-turn prompts (pre-allocated page budget; unset = off, byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_ADMIT_COALESCE_MS` — gemma4 opt-in admission coalesce door: `N` ms in `1..=2000` (`off`/`0`/unset = admit on sight), holds arrivals that would invade a live decode batch so a window's arrivals land as one admission burst; refuses the async prefill lane; merging into one mixed step needs the chunked walk or a sub-budget prompt
- `PEGAINFER_ASYNC_PREFILL` — gemma4 opt-in overlap lane: `green:NN` prefills live-batch admissions on an SM-capped stream to protect decode tails (`shared` for comparison; unset = off; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` — gemma4 opt-in chunked walk: a mixed admission computes at most `N` prompt rows per step (`64 <= N <` the serving ceiling; unset = whole-prompt steps; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_GATHER_ROWS` / `PEGAINFER_MIX_MAX_PROMPTS` — gemma4 admission gather: how many prompt rows and how many prompts one mixed step may absorb (`1..=` the serving ceiling and `1..=` the decode slots; defaults gather only short bursts). Raising them lets a burst ride one step, which trades the median time to first token for the p99 tail and the wide-batch decode step; bad values refuse to start
- `PEGAINFER_MAX_CONTEXT` — gemma4 serving ceiling raise (default 8192, up to the checkpoint's 262144; a raise past the default needs `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` and refuses the async lane)
- `PEGAINFER_DECODE_SLOTS` — gemma4 decode slots (1..16, default 16): global KV budget = slots x ceiling, trade concurrency for context
- `GLM52_DECODE_SLOTS` / `GLM52_MTP_DRAFTS` — glm52 runtime profile: decode slots per rank (default 8, ceiling 32) and MTP draft span (default 5); `slots x (1+drafts)` must fit the 96-row step (validated at launch; MTP only). Throughput ceiling profile: `32` / `2`.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP` — k3 opt-in context-parallel prefill lane: CP width, must equal the process's local rank count (on a fleet each process runs its own gang; remote ranks pad). Mutually exclusive with the dspark draft lane.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP_MIN` — k3 CP admission floor in prompt tokens (default 2048; measured crossover ~1k). Prompts below it, or too long for one chunk step per rank (M0), prefill locally.

## Architecture

```
HTTP Request → vLLM frontend → EngineHandle → per-model scheduler/executor → TokenEvent
                                               │
              ┌──────────┬─────────────┬───────┼───────────┬──────────┐
              │          │             │       │           │          │
        pegainfer-  pegainfer-   pegainfer-  pegainfer-  pegainfer-  ...
        qwen3       qwen35       dsv2-lite   kimi-k2     glm52
      (full attn) (linear+full) (MoE+EP)   (MLA+MoE)  (MLA+MoE+FP8)
              │          │             │       │           │          │
              └──────────┴─────────────┴───────┼───────────┴──────────┘
                                               │
                          pegainfer-core runtime + pegainfer-kernels
                                               │
                               ┌───────────────┼───────────────┐
                               │               │               │
                       CUDA / cuBLAS    Triton AOT      FlashInfer
                                                    (sampling, attention,
                                                     norm, MLA decode)
```

**Key abstractions:**

- **`pegainfer-frontend`** — the serving frontend: the engine request/event contract (`pegainfer_frontend::engine` — `EngineHandle`, `GenerateRequest`, `TokenEvent`) plus the protocol stacks on top of it (`vllm` module today, `dynamo` planned) and the `ModelLine` dispatch trait. Model crates implement against the contract; the server binary does pure dispatch.
- **Per-model crates** — each model owns config, weights, prefill/decode execution, scheduler, tests, and benches.
- **`pegainfer-core::ops`** — shared GPU operator wrappers used by model crates.
- **`pegainfer-kernels`** — tensor/FFI/kernel build owner for CUDA, cuBLAS, FlashInfer, and Triton AOT. Model-specific kernels live in feature-gated submodules (`kimi_k2`, `glm52`).
- **CUDA Graph** — decode path captured inside model executors with pre-allocated buffers to preserve pointer stability.
- **KV state** — model schedulers own request state; shared paged-KV primitives live in `pegainfer-kv-cache`; host/SSD/RDMA offload bridge in `pegainfer-kv-offload`.

**Build system**: the virtual workspace root has no package build script. `pegainfer-kernels/build.rs` owns CUDA/Triton compilation:
1. Compiles `pegainfer-kernels/csrc/*.cu` with nvcc (auto-detects GPU SM targets)
2. Feature-gated codegen: `qwen35` runs Triton AOT via `pegainfer-kernels/tools/triton/gen_triton_aot.py`; `kimi-k2` adds MLA/MoE/Marlin CUDA; `glm52` adds MLA/MoE/FP8 CUDA plus TileLang sparse-MLA codegen on sm_90a

## EP Free-Running Discipline

Canonical doc: `docs/models/glm52/free-running-dp.md` (K3's gang lane follows it). Invariants — violating any of these is a deadlock design:

- **No rank ever stops or waits.** Every engine loop runs unconditionally at full speed; idle ranks step with padding rows. Any quiet wait (condvar, sleep-poll) inside EP coordination is a bug, and the fleet is never asleep, so never design "wake up" or "pump until X" steps.
- **The per-step collective chain is fixed** — no conditional collectives. Skipping work happens inside kernels via zero-load padding entry, never by host negotiation.
- **The launch count is the global clock** (pairing pins all ranks within ±1 launch). Coordination means agreeing ahead of time on *what step N contains*, never "wait until everyone is ready".
- **Padding rows are protocol surface**: their bytes reach peers, so every dummy-row input must be constructively deterministic.

Collaboration centered on the `docs/` directory.

## Knowledge Architecture (domain-axis)

Docs are organized by what they're *about*, not by lifecycle stage. A doc's freshness lives in its TL;DR (and `Last touched:` for active areas) — not by which directory it sits in. Completed work stays co-located with its domain. There is no `archives/` directory — if a doc no longer earns its keep, delete it; if a lasting lesson hides inside it, lift that lesson into `lessons/` first, then delete.

```
docs/
├── index.md           # Routing table — every doc must be listed here
├── roadmap/           # Strategic plans, quarterly direction, milestones
├── models/<line>/     # Per-model living docs (qwen3, qwen35, kimi-k2, ...)
│                      # — design, accuracy, perf, refactor records, gotchas
├── subsystems/<area>/ # Cross-cutting components (runtime, scheduler, frontend, kernels)
├── playbooks/         # Reusable how-to: benching, profiling, accuracy, onboarding
├── lessons/           # Tribal knowledge from research / other projects
├── benchmarks/        # Standalone benchmark snapshots and eval reports
├── conventions/       # Ongoing standards (bench regression, coding style)
└── private/           # Local-only notes (gitignored)
```

Classification rule at capture time:
- Is it tied to a specific model? → `models/<line>/`
- A specific subsystem? → `subsystems/<area>/`
- Reusable how-to applicable across models? → `playbooks/`
- Lasting lesson from elsewhere (other repo, research, postmortem)? → `lessons/`
- Snapshot of measurement, not a doc that evolves? → `benchmarks/`
- Strategic / cross-cutting plan? → `roadmap/`

If you can't pick one, the doc probably needs splitting.

## Documentation Style

- Docs cover what `--help` and code can't: pitfalls, diagnostic paths, decision context. Don't restate CLI reference.
- Every command in a doc must be run and verified before committing. Unverified commands are technical debt.
- The only required header is a one-line **TL;DR**. Keep it true; that's the contract.
- For `models/<line>/` and `subsystems/<area>/` docs, add `Last touched: YYYY-MM` and bump it when you do meaningful work on the doc (not for typo fixes). The date is a fact, not a judgement — readers infer freshness themselves.
- `playbooks/`, `lessons/`, `conventions/`, `roadmap/`, `benchmarks/`, `archives/` don't need a freshness stamp. They're either timeless until disproven, or self-dated, or explicitly inert.
- No `Status:` enum. Enum fields go stale exactly when you need them most.

## index.md Drift Policy

`index.md` is a routing table with a scanning-friendly TL;DR column. It is *allowed to drift* from the TL;DR inside each doc — the doc body is authoritative. Update `index.md` when you create or delete a doc, or when the existing TL;DR is so wrong it actively misleads. Don't churn it on every doc edit.

## Core Principles (CODE)

Documentation exists to advance work, not to hoard information. Four steps when handling information:

1. **Capture**: Only record what materially advances the project. When in doubt, leave it out.
2. **Organize**: Action-oriented. Resist the urge to organize for organization's sake — structure should be just enough.
3. **Distill**: Refactor over append. When you learn something new or hit a pitfall, integrate it into the document body — don't pile a changelog at the bottom.
4. **Express**: Every document must point to a next step. Split unwieldy documents proactively. Active documents must note the current blocker or next action.

**Sync**

At the start of each session, you must read `index.md` and load the documents needed for the task at hand.

**Execute**
- Update relevant documents as you go. When a new problem or idea arises, create a document in the appropriate domain directory (see classification rule above).

**Commit**

When a session wraps up:

- Update `index.md` only when you created or deleted a doc, or when its TL;DR row is now misleading (see Drift Policy above).

46	### 4.1 ModelLine trait 与 probe：一条模型线如何被认领
47	
48	#### 4.1.1 概念说明
49	
50	**「模型线」（model line）= 一个模型家族的全部服务知识**：怎么识别它的 config.json、它有哪些专属 CLI 旗标、哪些旗标组合非法、怎么把 CLI 参数翻译成引擎启动调用。这些东西如果写在服务器里，服务器就会越来越懂每个模型，最终变成一团 `if qwen3 ... else if glm52 ...`。
51	
52	PegaInfer 的解法是把这一切下沉到模型 crate：frontend 只定义 trait（契约），服务器只做分派。frontend 模块头注释把这条缝说得很直白——服务器「never names a model crate's option types」（从不点名任何模型 crate 的选项类型），接入一条新模型线只需实现 `ModelLine` 并在服务器注册表里加一行（见 [pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs:1-12](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs#L1-L12) 的模块文档）。
53	
54	**probe 是认领动作**：服务器拿到模型目录的 `config.json`（解析成 `serde_json::Value`），挨个问每条编译进来的线「这是你的吗？」。恰好一条线接受 → 检测成功；两条都接受 → `DetectError::Conflict`；没人接受 → `DetectError::NoMatch`（服务器还会查一张 family 表，提示「这看起来像 X 模型，请用 `--features X` 重新构建」，见 [pegainfer-server/src/main.rs:123-144](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/src/main.rs#L123-L144)）。

62	2. registry.build_command(...)               共享旗标 + 每条线的专属旗标 → 一条完整命令（--help 不依赖检测结果）
63	3. 解析 argv                                 → matches + provided（显式提供的旗标集合）
64	4. 读 <model_path>/config.json               → serde_json::Value
65	5. registry.detect(&config)                  挨个 probe；NoMatch 时附加 feature 提示 → 得到唯一 line
66	6. registry.validate_provided(line, ...)     消费或拒绝：不归属的旗标报 UnconsumedFlag

70	8. line.launch(&ctx)（阻塞线程）              进入模型 crate 的启动链（4.4 详讲）
71	```

94	fn probe(&self, config: &serde_json::Value) -> Result<(), String> {

96	    let text_model_type = config

142	### 4.2 CLI 参数增补：augment_cli 与 consumed_shared_args
143	
144	#### 4.2.1 概念说明
145	
146	服务器的完整命令行由三层旗标拼成：
147	
148	| 层 | 定义处 | 例子 | 归属校验 |
149	|---|---|---|---|
150	| 核心旗标 | frontend `CORE_ARGS`（[L68-74](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs#L68-L74)） | `model_path`、`port`、`served_model_name`、`tool_call_parser` | 所有线都接受 |
151	| 共享旗标 | frontend `SharedArgs`（[L98-221](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs#L98-L221)） | `tp_size`、`cuda_graph`、`decode_overlap`、`kv_offload`、… | 只有所在线**声明消费**的子集被接受 |
152	| 线专属旗标 | 各模型 crate 的 `augment_cli` | `--qwen35-prefix-cache-mib`、`--max-batch`、`--qwen35-scheduler-policy` | 本线专属 |
153	
154	`SharedArgs` 是「多条线都可能用」的旗标池（例如 Qwen3 和 Qwen3.5 都支持 `--decode-overlap`，所以它放共享池）；每条线用 `consumed_shared_args` 声明自己读哪几个。**提供一条本线不消费的共享旗标不是「被忽略」，而是启动失败**——这就是消费或拒绝。
155	
156	Qwen3.5 声明消费 7 个共享旗标（[src/model_line.rs:95-105](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/model_line.rs#L95-L105)）：`device_ordinal`、`tp_size`、`cuda_graph`、`no_prefix_cache`、`max_prefill_tokens`、`decode_overlap`、`decode_sm_pct`。共享池里的其余旗标（如 `kv_offload`、`dp_size`、`dump_graph_png`、`dflash_draft_model_path`）对 Qwen3.5 都是「不认识」。
157	
158	还有一个值得注意的**类型边界**：CLI 侧的枚举（`CliQwen35SchedulerPolicy`）与引擎侧的枚举（[src/lib.rs:83-90](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/lib.rs#L83-L90) 的 `Qwen35SchedulerPolicy`）是两个类型，中间靠一个 `resolve()` 手工翻译。这让 clap 的 `ValueEnum` 不泄漏进引擎、引擎枚举不依赖 clap——两侧可以独立演化，翻译点是显式的、可审查的。
159	
160	#### 4.2.2 核心流程
161	
162	一个专属旗标的一生：
163	
164	```text
165	注册：ModelLineRegistry::new → line.augment_cli(cmd) → Qwen35Cli::augment_args(cmd)
166	      （registry 同时登记每个旗标的 id 与拼写，冲突即 panic —— release 构建里
167	        clap 自己的 schema 断言被关掉，所以注册表亲自做这件事）
168	使用：build_command 合成完整命令 → 用户 argv 解析成 matches
169	取回：line.cli(ctx) → Qwen35Cli::from_arg_matches(ctx.matches)
170	      （augment_cli 注册过这些 id，解析已成功，所以 from_arg_matches 的
171	        Err 分支用 expect 直接终止 —— 不可能到达）
172	校验：validate / launch 里读 cli 字段（4.3、4.4）
173	```
174	
175	#### 4.2.3 源码精读
176	
177	**（1）三个专属旗标的定义**。[src/model_line.rs:24-39](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/model_line.rs#L24-L39)：
178	
179	```rust
180	#[derive(ClapArgs)]
181	struct Qwen35Cli {
182	    /// Per-rank GPU budget in MiB for joint prefix snapshots; zero disables reuse.
183	    #[arg(long, default_value_t = 0)]
184	    qwen35_prefix_cache_mib: usize,
185	    /// Decode-batch capacity, 1..=64. Qwen3.5 internally rounds allocation to
186	    /// the next graph bucket but admits only this many scheduler slots; defaults to 64.
187	    #[arg(long)]
188	    max_batch: Option<usize>,
189	    /// Qwen3.5 prefill/decode scheduler policy. Defaults to `off`; `auto` is
190	    /// opt-in and currently single-GPU only.
191	    #[arg(long, value_enum, default_value_t = CliQwen35SchedulerPolicy::Off)]
192	    qwen35_scheduler_policy: CliQwen35SchedulerPolicy,
193	}
194	```
195	
196	三个设计点都藏在文档注释里：
197	
198	- `qwen35_prefix_cache_mib` 默认 0 = 关闭前缀缓存；大于 0 是「每 rank 快照显存预算（MiB）」。它对应的 `--no-prefix-cache` 是**共享**旗标——两者矛盾时由 4.3 的规则 2 拒绝（u6 会讲缓存本身）。
199	- `max_batch` 是 `Option<usize>`：CLI 层不设默认值，缺省语义（= 64）在 validate 与 launch 两处统一用 `unwrap_or(crate::MAX_DECODE_BATCH)` 补齐。注释还预告了「调度槽 vs 物理桶」的分离：内部按桶 `[1,2,4,8,16,32,64]`（[src/batch_decode_graph.rs:14](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/batch_decode_graph.rs#L14)）向上取整分配，但调度器只准入 `max_batch` 个槽（u4-l3 详讲）。
200	- `qwen35_scheduler_policy` 用 `value_enum` 接受 `off | auto`，默认 `off`；`auto` 的单 GPU 限制同样由 4.3 的规则 6 把守。
201	
202	**（2）CLI 枚举与引擎枚举之间的显式翻译**。[src/model_line.rs:41-58](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/model_line.rs#L41-L58)：`CliQwen35SchedulerPolicy::resolve()` 把 `Off/Auto` 逐一映射到 crate 的 `Qwen35SchedulerPolicy::Off/Auto`。同理 `resolve_decode_overlap`（[L64-72](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/model_line.rs#L64-L72)）把共享的 `CliDecodeOverlap`（`off | stream | green-ctx`）翻译成引擎的 `Qwen35DecodeOverlap`（`Off | SharedSm`），并把 Qwen3.5 不支持的 `green-ctx` 当场拒绝。
203	
204	**（3）augment_cli 与取回**。[src/model_line.rs:60-62](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/model_line.rs#L60-L62) 的 `cli(ctx)` 是 `validate` 和 `launch` 共用的取回入口：
205	
206	```rust
207	fn cli(ctx: &LaunchContext<'_>) -> Qwen35Cli {
208	    Qwen35Cli::from_arg_matches(ctx.matches).expect("Qwen35Cli parses from the merged command")
209	}
210	```
211	
212	`expect` 在这里不是冒险：`augment_cli` 已经把这些 id 注册进命令、整条 argv 已解析成功、注册表保证了 id 无冲突，所以 `from_arg_matches` 的错误分支实际不可达。
213	
214	**（4）注册表在构建期就把旗标归属查死**。`ModelLineRegistry::new`（[pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs:506-548](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs#L506-L548)）的注释点明动机：release 构建里 clap 等价的 schema 断言被禁用，所以注册表显式登记每个旗标 id 与拼写的归属，任何两条线（或线与共享池）撞 id、撞 `--spelling`、消费不存在的共享 id、声明悬空的依赖，都会在启动的第一行代码 panic——而不是等用户敲出某个旗标才炸。frontend 的内嵌测试用一组 StubLine 把这些 panic 场景全部钉住了。
215	
216	**（5）消费或拒绝的执行点**。[pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs:605-630](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs#L605-L630) 的 `validate_provided` 逐个检查 provided 集合：核心旗标 ∨ 被消费的共享旗标 ∨ 本线专属旗标，三者都不是则返回 `CliError::UnconsumedFlag`，错误形如 `--kv-offload is not used by Qwen3.5`。

229	#### 4.2.5 小练习与答案
230	
231	**练习 1**：为什么 `--decode-overlap` 放在共享池而 `--qwen35-scheduler-policy` 是专属旗标？
232	
233	答案：多条线支持同一语义的重叠模式（Qwen3 支持 `off|stream|green-ctx`，Qwen3.5 支持 `off|stream`），共享池让它们的拼写与帮助文本统一、由各线的 `resolve`/`validate` 决定接受哪些值；而调度策略目前只有 Qwen3.5 有，专属旗标避免污染其他线的命令面。

236	
237	答案：被接受（1..=64 内，内嵌测试 `accepts_non_bucket_scheduler_max_batch` 钉住）。物理分配向上取整到桶 8，但调度器只准入 5 个槽——「调度槽数」与「物理桶容量」是两个量，这正是旗标文档注释里写明的语义（#470 引入的分离）。

240	
241	答案：不会。CLI 枚举是独立的 `CliQwen35SchedulerPolicy`，`resolve()` 是唯一翻译点；引擎加变体后必须显式改 CLI 枚举与 `resolve`，否则新策略无法从命令行到达。这个「不自动」正是类型边界的价值：CLI 契约的每次变化都是显式的。

243	### 4.3 validate：跨旗标规则组成的校验链
244	
245	#### 4.3.1 概念说明
246	
247	三层校验各管一段：**clap 管格式**（值能不能解析成 `usize`）、**注册表管归属**（旗标是不是这条线的）、**`validate` 管语义组合**（每个旗标单看都合法，合在一起是否矛盾）。第三层就是 [src/model_line.rs:107-149](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/model_line.rs#L107-L149) 的 `ModelLine::validate`。
248	
249	Qwen3.5 的 `validate` 是一条**有序规则链**：六条检查按固定顺序执行，第一条命中即返回。顺序本身就是信息——它决定了用户看到哪条错误信息。注意签名里的 `_provided`（未使用）：Qwen3.5 的规则读的是旗标**值**而非「是否提供」，基于提供与否的规则放在共享层（如 `SharedArgs::validate` 要求 `--decode-sm-pct` 只能配合 `green-ctx` 出现，[frontend L248-252](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs#L248-L252)）。
250	
251	#### 4.3.2 核心流程
252	
253	`validate` 的决策树（条件按代码顺序）：
254	
255	```text
256	输入: cli（Qwen35Cli） + ctx.shared（共享旗标）
257	
258	R1  resolve_decode_overlap:
259	      green-ctx           → 拒绝 "supports --decode-overlap=off|stream only"
260	      off / stream        → Off / SharedSm
261	R2  qwen35_prefix_cache_mib > 0 且 no_prefix_cache
262	                          → 拒绝 "contradictory"
263	R3  max_batch（若提供）∉ 1..=64（MAX_DECODE_BATCH）
264	                          → 拒绝 "must be in 1..=64"
265	R4  overlap ≠ Off 且 max_batch（缺省补 64）> 32（MAX_SHARED_SM_DECODE_BATCH）
266	                          → 拒绝 "requires --max-batch <= 32"
267	R5  tp_size > 1 且 overlap ≠ Off
268	                          → 拒绝 "single-GPU only"
269	R6  tp_size > 1 且 policy = Auto
270	                          → 拒绝 "single-GPU only"（TP 固定 off 策略）
271	全部通过 → Ok(())
272	```
273	
274	每条规则都有内嵌测试钉住：R2 ← `rejects_contradictory_prefix_cache_flags`、R3 ← `rejects_zero_scheduler_max_batch`、R4 ← `rejects_stream_overlap_default_max_batch` 与 `accepts_shared_stream_overlap`（边界 32 恰好通过）、R1 ← `rejects_green_context_overlap`、R5/R6 ← `accepts_tp_size` / `rejects_tp_auto_scheduler_policy`。
275	
276	#### 4.3.3 源码精读
277	
278	**（1）R4 为什么是 32**。上限常量在 [src/lib.rs:44-51](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/lib.rs#L44-L51)：
279	
280	```rust
281	/// Current safe Qwen3.5 Shared-SM overlap admission cap.
282	///
283	/// Decode buckets above this value fall back to the prefill cuBLAS handle today.
284	/// Replaying decode while async prefill concurrently calls that same handle from
285	/// another stream relies on undocumented single-handle multi-stream behavior.
286	pub const MAX_SHARED_SM_DECODE_BATCH: usize = ops::GEMM_LT_MAX_N;
287	```
288	
289	即 `GEMM_LT_MAX_N = 32`（[pegainfer-kernels/src/ops/linear.rs:224](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-kernels/src/ops/linear.rs#L224)）。语义是：`stream` 重叠模式让 decode 在模型流重放图、prefill 在第二条流跑 chunk；大于 32 的解码桶今天仍会回落到 prefill 的 cuBLAS handle，「另一条流并发调用同一个 handle」依赖 cuBLAS 未公开的多流行为——所以在更大的桶拥有独立的 per-stream handle 之前，重叠模式被限制在 ≤ 32（u4-l4 详讲重叠本身）。
290	
291	**（2）R4 的缺省补齐**。[src/model_line.rs:127-135](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/model_line.rs#L127-L135)：`let max_batch = cli.max_batch.unwrap_or(crate::MAX_DECODE_BATCH);`——用户没写 `--max-batch` 时按 64 校验。所以 `--decode-overlap stream` 单独出现必被 R4 拒绝（64 > 32），必须显式配 `--max-batch 32` 或更小。这不是缺陷而是刻意的保守：默认配置不允许悄悄进入「未公开 cuBLAS 行为」的区域。
292	
293	**（3）规则顺序的可见后果**。`--tp-size 2 --decode-overlap stream`（不带 `--max-batch`）报的是 R4 的「requires --max-batch <= 32」而不是 R5 的「single-GPU only」——因为 R4 先执行且缺省 64 已违规。想看到 R5 的信息需要再配 `--max-batch 16`。读错误信息定位规则时要意识到这一点。
294	
295	**（4）一个跨层死角的推理：`--decode-sm-pct` 与 Qwen3.5**。Qwen3.5 把 `decode_sm_pct` 列入 consumed（R5 之前它是 green-ctx 专属参数），但：提供它且 overlap 非 green-ctx → 共享层 `SharedArgs::validate` 拒绝（「only applies with green-ctx」）；提供它且 green-ctx → R1 拒绝（Qwen3.5 不支持 green-ctx）。两条路都死，`--decode-sm-pct` 实际无法与 Qwen3.5 一起使用。把它列入 consumed 的收益是错误信息更贴切（「参数只属于 green-ctx」而非干巴巴的「not used by Qwen3.5」）——归属声明也承担「解释」职责。
296	
297	**（5）测试助手 `validate_argv` 为什么可信**。[src/model_line.rs:192-203](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/model_line.rs#L192-L203) 调用的 `parse_for_line`（[frontend L668-681](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs#L668-L681)）内部走的是与服务器完全相同的路径：单线注册表 → `build_command` → 解析 → `validate_provided` → `shared.validate`，最后才补上 `line.validate`。因此内嵌单测验证的就是生产分派链本身，不是简化替身。

327	### 4.4 serve_plan 与 launch：从 CLI 到引擎启动链
328	
329	#### 4.4.1 概念说明
330	
331	两个收尾方法回答两个不同的问题：
332	
333	- **`serve_plan`：引擎还没加载，前端就需要知道什么？** 服务器要在引擎加载完成前注册 HTTP 身份、决定路由（LoRA、prefill-only、分区数）、解析工具调用语法——这些都只能从 CLI 派生。`ServePlan`（[frontend L293-334](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs#L293-L334)）有四个字段，Qwen3.5 只设置其中一个：`auto_tool_call_parser`。
334	- **`launch`：把 CLI 世界翻译成引擎世界。** `LaunchContext` 里的字符串与旗标在这里变成 `Qwen35LaunchOptions`（[src/lib.rs:121-133](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/lib.rs#L121-L133)）加上两个引擎枚举，进入启动函数族。同时，CLI 层校验过的规则在库边界**再校验一遍**——纵深防御，因为库函数也能被测试和其他 crate 直接调用，绕过 CLI。
335	
336	#### 4.4.2 核心流程
337	
338	`launch` 之后的完整调用链（单 GPU 与 TP 在最深处分叉，u1-l3 的 4.1 已见过这个分叉）：
339	
340	```text
341	ModelLine::launch                                  [model_line.rs:163-183]
342	  ├── 组装 Qwen35LaunchOptions（max_batch / max_prefill_tokens 缺省补齐）
343	  ├── resolve_decode_overlap（第二次翻译；green-ctx 在此转成 anyhow 错误）
344	  └── launch_with_options_policy_and_overlap       [lib.rs:166-188]
345	        ├── device_ordinals()  校验 tp_size >= 1；tp=1 → [device_ordinal]，否则 0..tp_size
346	        ├── 组装 EngineLoadOptions（seed=42、EpBackend::Nccl、设备表）
347	        └── start_engine_with_capacity_policy_and_overlap   [lib.rs:225-308]
348	              ├── 再校验 max_batch ∈ 1..=64            （与 R3 同款）
349	              ├── 再校验 SharedSm ⇒ max_batch <= 32     （与 R4 同款）
350	              ├── prefix_cache_mib × 1MiB 溢出检查
351	              ├── 多设备（TP）分支:
352	              │     拒绝 overlap / auto 策略 → scheduler::start_tp_with_capacity
353	              └── 单 GPU 分支:
354	                    强制 enable_cuda_graph（"Qwen3.5 decode always captures CUDA Graphs"）
355	                    → weights::Qwen35Model::from_safetensors（加载权重）
356	                    → scheduler::start_with_capacity_and_policy
357	```
358	
359	#### 4.4.3 源码精读
360	
361	**（1）serve_plan：一条注释里藏着一个线上 bug**。[src/model_line.rs:151-161](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/model_line.rs#L151-L161)：
362	
363	```rust
364	fn serve_plan(&self, _ctx: &LaunchContext<'_>) -> Result<ServePlan, CliError> {
365	    Ok(ServePlan {
366	        // Both generations' templates request the Qwen Coder tool syntax,
367	        // but upstream `Auto` matches the model *path* by substring: a
368	        // `Qwen3.8-27B` directory resolves to the JSON `qwen3_json` parser
369	        // (`docs/models/qwen35/support-qwen38.md`). The line knows better
370	        // than the directory name.
371	        auto_tool_call_parser: Some(ParserSelection::Explicit("qwen3_coder".to_string())),
372	        ..Default::default()
373	    })
374	}
375	```
376	
377	完整因果链（实测记录见 [docs/models/qwen35/support-qwen38.md:180-186](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/docs/models/qwen35/support-qwen38.md#L180-L186)）：
378	
379	1. Qwen3.5 和 Qwen3.8 两代模型的聊天模板都用 **Qwen Coder 工具调用语法**。
380	2. 但 `--tool-call-parser auto` 的上游实现是按**模型路径子串**匹配：路径含 `qwen3.5` 才选 `qwen3_coder`，只含 `qwen3` 的路径落到 `qwen3_json`。
381	3. 一个名为 `Qwen3.8-27B` 的目录因此被解析成 `qwen3_json`——工具调用块不被解析，原样落进 `content` 字段（实测观察到的错误行为）。
382	4. 修复：模型线在 `ServePlan` 里自己声明 `auto → qwen3_coder`，「线比目录名更了解自己」。用户**显式**指定的 parser（包括 `none`）永远优先——[frontend L311-323](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs#L311-L323) 的 `resolve_tool_call_parser` 只在请求为 `Auto` 时才回退到线的默认。
383	
384	这一行为被 [src/model_line.rs:329-352](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/model_line.rs#L329-L352) 的 `auto_tool_call_parser_resolves_to_the_coder_parser` 双向钉住：`Auto` 必须变成 `qwen3_coder`，显式 `qwen3_xml` 必须原样存活。
385	
386	**（2）launch 的参数翻译**。[src/model_line.rs:163-183](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/model_line.rs#L163-L183)：三个输入源在此汇合——专属旗标（`qwen35_prefix_cache_mib`、`max_batch`）、消费的共享旗标（`device_ordinal`、`tp_size`、`cuda_graph`、`max_prefill_tokens`）、两个 `resolve` 的产物（策略与重叠模式）。缺省补齐点：`max_batch.unwrap_or(MAX_DECODE_BATCH)`、`max_prefill_tokens.unwrap_or(DEFAULT_MAX_PREFILL_TOKENS)`。最后 `.map(LaunchedEngine::Stepped)` 把引擎包进 frontend 契约的枚举——Qwen3.5 返回的是 step 驱动型引擎。
387	
388	**（3）库边界的纵深防御**。[src/lib.rs:234-249](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/lib.rs#L234-L249) 把 R3、R4 原样再查一遍；[L253-262](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/lib.rs#L253-L262) 把 R5、R6 再查一遍。这不是冗余：`start_engine*` 函数族是公开库 API，测试（如 [lib.rs:345-415](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/lib.rs#L345-L415) 的三个 `*_before_loading_model` 测试）和外部 crate 都能绕过 CLI 直接调用。两层校验的分工：**CLI 层给出用户友好的快失败（连引擎都还没开始构建），库层是不变量的权威边界**。lib 测试名里的 `before_loading_model` 强调这些检查发生在任何权重加载之前——非法参数不该浪费一次显存初始化。
389	
390	**（4）`ServePlan` 为什么用 `..Default::default()`**。frontend 的 [ServePlan 文档](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs#L293-L309) 解释了原因：CI 会编译多条模型线，任何 crate 里写全字段的花括号字面量都会在 frontend 给 `ServePlan` 加字段的那天悄悄过时——只拼自己设置的字段，新增字段自然落入默认值。

474	**第 5 步（可选扩展）**：按任务说明的替代方案，仿照 [rejects_green_context_overlap](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/model_line.rs#L275-L279) 自己复写一个变体（例如同时断言信息含 `off|stream` 与 `Qwen3.5`），体会 R1 的错误措辞。
475	
476	### 需要观察的现象
477	
478	- 新测试与既有 12 个 model_line 测试全部通过。
479	- 测试是纯主机侧逻辑：不加载权重、不初始化 CUDA（`validate_argv` 只做参数解析与规则判定）。
480	- 但**构建**仍需 `--features qwen35` 拉起的 Triton AOT 工具链（u1-l2 讲过的构建期 Python 依赖）。
481	
482	### 预期结果
483	
484	第 1 步表格第一行的答案：**拒绝，R4**（40 > 32，错误信息含 `max-batch`、`32`、`got 40`）。测试运行通过即证实预测。本环境未执行上述命令（构建需要 Triton AOT 工具链），**待本地验证**；预测本身可由 [src/model_line.rs:119-135](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/model_line.rs#L119-L135) 的代码直接推得，不依赖运行。
485	
486	## 6. 本讲小结
487	
488	- **ModelLine 是缝，服务器是纯分派**：trait 把「识别 config、专属旗标、跨旗标规则、服务计划、启动」全部下沉到模型 crate（[src/model_line.rs:74-184](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/model_line.rs#L74-L184)）；服务器二进制只持有 `Vec<&'static dyn ModelLine>` 做注册、检测、校验、启动四步转发。
489	- **probe 认身份不认版本**：两段式（外层 `model_type`/`text_config.model_type` 之「或」+ 内层三字段之「与」），Qwen3.8 因身份三元组与 Qwen3.5 逐字段相同而被同一条线认领——「共用一条线」在代码上就是 probe 的四个字符串常量。
490	- **旗标三层归属 + 消费或拒绝**：`--qwen35-prefix-cache-mib`、`--max-batch`、`--qwen35-scheduler-policy` 专属，7 个共享旗标被声明消费，其余共享旗标提供即报 `--xxx is not used by Qwen3.5`；注册表在构建期用 panic 查死 id/拼写冲突。
491	- **validate 是有序规则链**：六条检查（green-ctx 不支持、前缀缓存矛盾、批次 1..=64、重叠批次 ≤ 32、TP 拒重叠、TP 拒 auto）顺序执行、首错即返；32 的上限来自 cuBLAS 单 handle 多流的未公开行为风险（`GEMM_LT_MAX_N`）。
492	- **serve_plan 修过一个真实 bug**：上游 `auto` 按路径子串选 parser，`Qwen3.8-27B` 目录会落到 `qwen3_json` 导致工具调用不被解析；线声明 `auto → qwen3_coder`，显式选择仍然优先。
493	- **纵深防御**：同一批规则在 CLI 的 `validate` 与库的 `start_engine_with_capacity_policy_and_overlap` 各查一遍——前者面向用户快失败，后者是不变量的权威边界（库可被绕过 CLI 直接调用）；内嵌测试经 `parse_for_line` 走的正是生产分派链。
494	
495	## 7. 下一步学习建议
496	
497	入门单元到此完成：你已经知道这条线是什么（u1-l1）、怎么构建（u1-l2）、代码怎么组织（u1-l3）、怎么被服务器接入（本讲）。下一讲 **u2-l1「config.json 的解析与校验」**顺着 probe 的第二段往里走：精读 [src/config/model.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/config/model.rs)，看 `RawConfig` 如何经 `TryFrom` 一次性校验成合法的 `Config35`——本讲 probe 只验了门牌号，u2 开始验户型。
498	
499	进入 u2 前的两个轻量准备：
500	
501	1. 通读 [pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs) 的 frontend 侧内嵌测试（StubLine 家族那一段）——你会看到「注册表用 panic 当断言」的完整测试面，与本讲 4.2 的归属机制互为印证。
502	2. 完成 4.3.4 的推演表后，把 5 的表格留着：u5-l1 讲调度器时我们会回到 `max_batch` / `max_prefill_tokens` 这两个值真正被谁消费，届时你会看到 CLI 层这两个数字在调度器里的最终形态。

# ModelLine 接入：probe、CLI 增补与服务计划

## 1. 本讲目标

学完本讲，你应该能够：

1. 说清 [`ModelLine`](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs#L337-L383) 这个 trait 是服务器二进制与模型 crate 之间的「缝」，以及服务器为什么能做到「纯分派、不认识任何模型的类型」。
2. 解释 `probe` 如何通过 `model_type` / `text_config.model_type` 认领 Qwen3.5 与 Qwen3.8（以及为什么 Qwen3.8 不需要一条新线）。
3. 追踪 `--qwen35-prefix-cache-mib`、`--max-batch`、`--qwen35-scheduler-policy` 三个专属旗标从 `augment_cli` 注册、到 `validate` 跨旗标校验、再到 `launch` 进入启动链的完整路径。
4. 说明 `serve_plan` 里 `auto_tool_call_parser` 解析为 `qwen3_coder` 的原因（这是一个真实的线上 bug 的防御）。
5. 参照内嵌 tests 的写法，自己新增一个「`--decode-overlap stream` 配超大 `--max-batch` 被拒绝」的单测并运行。

本讲是入门单元（u1）的最后一讲：u1-l3 的模块地图说 `pub mod model_line` 是 crate 三层公开面的「正门」，本讲就把这扇门整个打开。

## 2. 前置知识

先 recall 前三讲的两个结论：

- **混合架构 → 一条线两种注意力**（u1-l1）：Qwen3.5 是全注意力 + Gated DeltaNet 线性注意力的混合模型，Qwen3.8 与它共用同一条模型线。本讲会看到「共用一条线」在代码上到底意味着什么——probe 认领的是同一套身份字符串。
- **feature 门控**（u1-l2）：整个 crate 活在 `#![cfg(feature = "qwen35")]` 之后，`cargo test -p pegainfer-qwen35 --features qwen35 --lib` 这类命令需要构建期 Python + Triton 工具链。本讲的实践任务最后会用到这条命令。

再补充四个本讲要用到的 Rust / clap 概念：

- **trait 与 trait 对象**：`&'static dyn ModelLine` 是动态分派的 trait 对象。服务器持有 `Vec<&'static dyn ModelLine>`，运行时按 config.json 挑出一条线来调它的方法——服务器因此不需要为每条线泛型化，也不需要 `use` 任何模型 crate 的具体类型。
- **clap 的 derive 模式**：`#[derive(clap::Args)]` 的结构体可以用 `augment_args(cmd)` 把自己的字段注册成 CLI 旗标（字段名 `qwen35_prefix_cache_mib` 自动变成旗标 `--qwen35-prefix-cache-mib`）；`FromArgMatches` 则反过来，从一次解析结果中取回这个结构体。`#[derive(ValueEnum)]` 让枚举成为旗标的可选值集合。
- **「显式提供」与默认值的区别**：clap 里每个旗标都可能带默认值，但校验逻辑常常只关心**用户真正敲过**的旗标。frontend 的 [`provided_args`](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs#L641-L661) 用 `ValueSource::CommandLine | EnvVariable` 过滤出这个集合（`BTreeSet<String>`，存的是旗标 id）。
- **消费或拒绝（consume-or-reject）**：PegaInfer 的 CLI 设计纪律——每条被提供的旗标必须有明确归属：要么是核心旗标，要么是被当前模型线**声明消费**的共享旗标，要么是本线专属旗标。三者都不是 → 启动直接报错。这防止「用户传了个旗标但当前模型根本不理它」的静默失效。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| 文件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| [src/model_line.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/model_line.rs)（353 行） | **本讲主角**：`Qwen35Line` 对 `ModelLine` 的完整实现 + 12 个内嵌单测 |
| [src/lib.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/lib.rs)（416 行） | `launch` 的目的地：`Qwen35LaunchOptions`、两个引擎枚举、启动函数族的纵深校验 |
| [src/config/mod.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/config/mod.rs)（51 行） | `probe_config_json`：probe 的第二段身份检查 |
| [src/batch_decode_graph.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/batch_decode_graph.rs#L14-L28) | `MAX_BATCH = 64` 与 CUDA Graph 桶 `[1,2,4,8,16,32,64]`——`--max-batch` 的物理背景 |
| [pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs)（988 行） | trait 定义、`SharedArgs` 共享旗标池、`ModelLineRegistry` 注册表、测试助手 `parse_for_line` |
| [pegainfer-server/src/main.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/src/main.rs#L146-L213) | 服务器主流程：注册 → 解析 → 检测 → 校验 → 启动，全部是分派 |
| [pegainfer-kernels/src/ops/linear.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-kernels/src/ops/linear.rs#L224) | `GEMM_LT_MAX_N = 32`：`--decode-overlap=stream` 批次上限的源头 |
| [docs/models/qwen35/support-qwen38.md](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/docs/models/qwen35/support-qwen38.md) | Qwen3.8 共线的实测记录；`auto_tool_call_parser` 决策的依据 |

阅读建议：本讲以 `src/model_line.rs` 为主线精读；frontend 的 trait 文件只读模块头注释、trait 定义、`SharedArgs`、`parse_for_line` 四处；server 的 `main.rs` 读主流程一段即可。

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 ModelLine trait 与 probe：一条模型线如何被认领

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

**「模型线」（model line）= 一个模型家族的全部服务知识**：怎么识别它的 config.json、它有哪些专属 CLI 旗标、哪些旗标组合非法、怎么把 CLI 参数翻译成引擎启动调用。这些东西如果写在服务器里，服务器就会越来越懂每个模型，最终变成一团 `if qwen3 ... else if glm52 ...`。

PegaInfer 的解法是把这一切下沉到模型 crate：frontend 只定义 trait（契约），服务器只做分派。frontend 模块头注释把这条缝说得很直白——服务器「never names a model crate's option types」（从不点名任何模型 crate 的选项类型），接入一条新模型线只需实现 `ModelLine` 并在服务器注册表里加一行（见 [pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs:1-12](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs#L1-L12) 的模块文档）。

**probe 是认领动作**：服务器拿到模型目录的 `config.json`（解析成 `serde_json::Value`），挨个问每条编译进来的线「这是你的吗？」。恰好一条线接受 → 检测成功；两条都接受 → `DetectError::Conflict`；没人接受 → `DetectError::NoMatch`（服务器还会查一张 family 表，提示「这看起来像 X 模型，请用 `--features X` 重新构建」，见 [pegainfer-server/src/main.rs:123-144](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/src/main.rs#L123-L144)）。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

服务器一次启动的分派序列（对照 [pegainfer-server/src/main.rs:146-186](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-server/src/main.rs#L146-L186)）：

```text
1. ModelLineRegistry::new(model_lines())     构建注册表；构建期即校验旗标归属（重名/重拼写直接 panic）
2. registry.build_command(...)               共享旗标 + 每条线的专属旗标 → 一条完整命令（--help 不依赖检测结果）
3. 解析 argv                                 → matches + provided（显式提供的旗标集合）
4. 读 <model_path>/config.json               → serde_json::Value
5. registry.detect(&config)                  挨个 probe；NoMatch 时附加 feature 提示 → 得到唯一 line
6. registry.validate_provided(line, ...)     消费或拒绝：不归属的旗标报 UnconsumedFlag
   shared.validate(&provided)                共享旗标之间的通用规则
7. line.validate(&ctx, &provided)            本线跨旗标规则（4.3 详讲）
   line.serve_plan(&ctx)                     引擎加载前前端就要知道的事实（4.4 详讲）
8. line.launch(&ctx)（阻塞线程）              进入模型 crate 的启动链（4.4 详讲）
```

注意顺序：**检测先于一切校验**——必须先知道是哪条线，才知道该用哪套规则去校验。

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

**（1）trait 契约：七个方法，三个有默认实现**。[pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs:337-383](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs#L337-L383)：

| 方法 | 作用 | Qwen35Line 是否覆盖 |
|---|---|---|
| `name()` | 家族名，出现在日志、错误信息、`--help` | ✅ 返回 `"Qwen3.5"`（[src/model_line.rs:75-77](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/model_line.rs#L75-L77)） |
| `probe(config)` | 按 config.json 认领或拒绝 | ✅（下文详讲） |
| `augment_cli(cmd)` | 追加本线专属旗标 | ✅（4.2 详讲） |
| `consumed_shared_args()` | 本线读取哪些共享旗标 | ✅（4.2 详讲） |
| `arg_requirements()` | 旗标间的无条件依赖 | ❌ 用默认空（依赖关系简单，靠 `validate` 表达） |
| `validate(ctx, provided)` | 跨旗标规则 | ✅（4.3 详讲） |
| `serve_plan(ctx)` / `launch(ctx)` | 服务计划 / 启动引擎 | ✅ / ✅（4.4 详讲） |

`validate` 与 `launch` 之间靠 [`LaunchContext`](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs#L273-L284) 传递四个字段：`model_path`（模型目录）、`config`（probe 已接受的同一份 config.json）、`shared`（共享旗标解析结果）、`matches`（完整命令的解析结果——线用它取回自己的专属旗标）。

**（2）probe 的两段式结构**。[src/model_line.rs:79-89](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/model_line.rs#L79-L89)：

```rust
fn probe(&self, config: &serde_json::Value) -> Result<(), String> {
    let model_type = config.get("model_type").and_then(serde_json::Value::as_str);
    let text_model_type = config
        .get("text_config")
        .and_then(|text| text.get("model_type"))
        .and_then(serde_json::Value::as_str);
    if model_type != Some("qwen3_5") && text_model_type != Some("qwen3_5_text") {
        return Err(format!("model_type {model_type:?} is not \"qwen3_5\""));
    }
    crate::probe_config_json(config).map_err(|error| error.to_string())
}
```

- **第一段是「或」**：`model_type` 和 `text_config.model_type` 只要有一个像 Qwen3.5，就继续往下查；两个都不像才立刻拒绝（这条拒绝理由会进入 `NoMatch` 错误的 rejections 列表）。
- **第二段是「与」**：[src/config/mod.rs:24-51](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/config/mod.rs#L24-L51) 的 `probe_config_json` 要求三件事**全部**成立——`model_type == "qwen3_5"`、`architectures` 包含 `"Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration"`、`text_config.model_type == "qwen3_5_text"`。它的文档注释明确划界：「身份检查归 probe，尺寸和形状校验归 config loader」——probe 只认门牌号，不验户型。

两段式的实际效果：一个 `model_type: "qwen3_5"` 但 architectures 写错的 config，第一段放行、第二段给出精确的「architectures must contain Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration」；一个完全外来的 config 则在第一段就拿到简洁的「not qwen3_5」。

**（3）Qwen3.8 为什么不需要新线**。实测记录（[docs/models/qwen35/support-qwen38.md:35](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/docs/models/qwen35/support-qwen38.md#L35)）：Qwen3.8-27B 的 config.json 报告的身份三元组与 Qwen3.5 **逐字段相同**（`model_type: qwen3_5` / `Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration` / `qwen3_5_text`），文本塔几何也一致——所以 probe、权重、内核、调度器、服务器接线全部原样通过。它真正的差异在加载器（bf16 标量）和聊天模板，与本讲的 CLI 层无关。**probe 认领的是身份，不是版本号**：对它来说 Qwen3.5 和 Qwen3.8 是同一个身份的两次落地。

**（4）内嵌测试已经钉住了 probe 行为**。[src/model_line.rs:218-228](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/model_line.rs#L218-L228) 的 `probe_accepts_qwen35_identity` 用一个三字段齐全的 JSON 断言接受——这就是「合法 config.json 长什么样」的可执行文档。

#### 4.1.4 代码实践

**实践：手工推演一次 detect，验证「恰好一条线认领」的必要性。**

1. **实践目标**：理解 detect 的冲突语义，以及为什么 probe 的错误信息会出现在用户面前。
2. **操作步骤**：
   - 读 [pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs:569-601](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs#L569-L601) 的 `detect`：注意它怎么收集 rejections、怎么在第二个认领者出现时返回 `Conflict`。

#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：一个 config.json 有 `model_type: "qwen3_5"` 但 `architectures: ["Qwen3NextForCausalLM"]`，probe 的结果是什么？

**练习 2**：detect 为什么要求**恰好**一条线认领？两条都认领会发生什么？

答案：认领的线决定后续一切：旗标归属校验用它的 `consumed_shared_args` 与专属旗标，校验规则用它的 `validate`，启动用它的 `launch`。两条线都认领时这套决策无法进行，所以 `detect` 返回 `DetectError::Conflict`，把两条线的名字都写进错误信息（frontend 有对应单测 `detect_conflict_names_both_lines`）。

**练习 3**：Qwen3.8-27B 放进 `--model-path`，服务器日志里 `line.name()` 会打出什么？为什么不是 "Qwen3.8"？

答案：打出 `Qwen3.5`。因为 Qwen3.8 的 config.json 身份三元组与 Qwen3.5 相同，被同一条 `Qwen35Line` 认领；`name()` 是线的名字，不是 checkpoint 的名字。

### 4.2 CLI 参数增补：augment_cli 与 consumed_shared_args

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

服务器的完整命令行由三层旗标拼成：

| 层 | 定义处 | 例子 | 归属校验 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 核心旗标 | frontend `CORE_ARGS`（[L68-74](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs#L68-L74)） | `model_path`、`port`、`served_model_name`、`tool_call_parser` | 所有线都接受 |
| 共享旗标 | frontend `SharedArgs`（[L98-221](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs#L98-L221)） | `tp_size`、`cuda_graph`、`decode_overlap`、`kv_offload`、… | 只有所在线**声明消费**的子集被接受 |
| 线专属旗标 | 各模型 crate 的 `augment_cli` | `--qwen35-prefix-cache-mib`、`--max-batch`、`--qwen35-scheduler-policy` | 本线专属 |

`SharedArgs` 是「多条线都可能用」的旗标池（例如 Qwen3 和 Qwen3.5 都支持 `--decode-overlap`，所以它放共享池）；每条线用 `consumed_shared_args` 声明自己读哪几个。**提供一条本线不消费的共享旗标不是「被忽略」，而是启动失败**——这就是消费或拒绝。

Qwen3.5 声明消费 7 个共享旗标（[src/model_line.rs:95-105](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/model_line.rs#L95-L105)）：`device_ordinal`、`tp_size`、`cuda_graph`、`no_prefix_cache`、`max_prefill_tokens`、`decode_overlap`、`decode_sm_pct`。共享池里的其余旗标（如 `kv_offload`、`dp_size`、`dump_graph_png`、`dflash_draft_model_path`）对 Qwen3.5 都是「不认识」。

还有一个值得注意的**类型边界**：CLI 侧的枚举（`CliQwen35SchedulerPolicy`）与引擎侧的枚举（[src/lib.rs:83-90](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/lib.rs#L83-L90) 的 `Qwen35SchedulerPolicy`）是两个类型，中间靠一个 `resolve()` 手工翻译。这让 clap 的 `ValueEnum` 不泄漏进引擎、引擎枚举不依赖 clap——两侧可以独立演化，翻译点是显式的、可审查的。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

一个专属旗标的一生：

```text
注册：ModelLineRegistry::new → line.augment_cli(cmd) → Qwen35Cli::augment_args(cmd)
      （registry 同时登记每个旗标的 id 与拼写，冲突即 panic —— release 构建里
        clap 自己的 schema 断言被关掉，所以注册表亲自做这件事）
使用：build_command 合成完整命令 → 用户 argv 解析成 matches
取回：line.cli(ctx) → Qwen35Cli::from_arg_matches(ctx.matches)
      （augment_cli 注册过这些 id，解析已成功，所以 from_arg_matches 的
        Err 分支用 expect 直接终止 —— 不可能到达）
校验：validate / launch 里读 cli 字段（4.3、4.4）
```

#### 4.2.3 源码精读

**（1）三个专属旗标的定义**。[src/model_line.rs:24-39](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/model_line.rs#L24-L39)：

```rust
#[derive(ClapArgs)]
struct Qwen35Cli {
    /// Per-rank GPU budget in MiB for joint prefix snapshots; zero disables reuse.
    #[arg(long, default_value_t = 0)]
    qwen35_prefix_cache_mib: usize,
    /// Decode-batch capacity, 1..=64. Qwen3.5 internally rounds allocation to
    /// the next graph bucket but admits only this many scheduler slots; defaults to 64.
    #[arg(long)]
    max_batch: Option<usize>,
    /// Qwen3.5 prefill/decode scheduler policy. Defaults to `off`; `auto` is
    /// opt-in and currently single-GPU only.
    #[arg(long, value_enum, default_value_t = CliQwen35SchedulerPolicy::Off)]
    qwen35_scheduler_policy: CliQwen35SchedulerPolicy,
}
```

三个设计点都藏在文档注释里：

- `qwen35_prefix_cache_mib` 默认 0 = 关闭前缀缓存；大于 0 是「每 rank 快照显存预算（MiB）」。它对应的 `--no-prefix-cache` 是**共享**旗标——两者矛盾时由 4.3 的规则 2 拒绝（u6 会讲缓存本身）。
- `max_batch` 是 `Option<usize>`：CLI 层不设默认值，缺省语义（= 64）在 validate 与 launch 两处统一用 `unwrap_or(crate::MAX_DECODE_BATCH)` 补齐。注释还预告了「调度槽 vs 物理桶」的分离：内部按桶 `[1,2,4,8,16,32,64]`（[src/batch_decode_graph.rs:14](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/batch_decode_graph.rs#L14)）向上取整分配，但调度器只准入 `max_batch` 个槽（u4-l3 详讲）。
- `qwen35_scheduler_policy` 用 `value_enum` 接受 `off | auto`，默认 `off`；`auto` 的单 GPU 限制同样由 4.3 的规则 6 把守。

**（2）CLI 枚举与引擎枚举之间的显式翻译**。[src/model_line.rs:41-58](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/model_line.rs#L41-L58)：`CliQwen35SchedulerPolicy::resolve()` 把 `Off/Auto` 逐一映射到 crate 的 `Qwen35SchedulerPolicy::Off/Auto`。同理 `resolve_decode_overlap`（[L64-72](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/model_line.rs#L64-L72)）把共享的 `CliDecodeOverlap`（`off | stream | green-ctx`）翻译成引擎的 `Qwen35DecodeOverlap`（`Off | SharedSm`），并把 Qwen3.5 不支持的 `green-ctx` 当场拒绝。

**（3）augment_cli 与取回**。[src/model_line.rs:60-62](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-qwen35/src/model_line.rs#L60-L62) 的 `cli(ctx)` 是 `validate` 和 `launch` 共用的取回入口：

```rust
fn cli(ctx: &LaunchContext<'_>) -> Qwen35Cli {
    Qwen35Cli::from_arg_matches(ctx.matches).expect("Qwen35Cli parses from the merged command")
}
```

`expect` 在这里不是冒险：`augment_cli` 已经把这些 id 注册进命令、整条 argv 已解析成功、注册表保证了 id 无冲突，所以 `from_arg_matches` 的错误分支实际不可达。

**（4）注册表在构建期就把旗标归属查死**。`ModelLineRegistry::new`（[pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs:506-548](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs#L506-L548)）的注释点明动机：release 构建里 clap 等价的 schema 断言被禁用，所以注册表显式登记每个旗标 id 与拼写的归属，任何两条线（或线与共享池）撞 id、撞 `--spelling`、消费不存在的共享 id、声明悬空的依赖，都会在启动的第一行代码 panic——而不是等用户敲出某个旗标才炸。frontend 的内嵌测试用一组 StubLine 把这些 panic 场景全部钉住了。

**（5）消费或拒绝的执行点**。[pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs:605-630](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/af9e40e12108141bb18f93188c82d2583df18509/pegainfer-frontend/src/model_line.rs#L605-L630) 的 `validate_provided` 逐个检查 provided 集合：核心旗标 ∨ 被消费的共享旗标 ∨ 本线专属旗标，三者都不是则返回 `CliError::UnconsumedFlag`，错误形如 `--kv-offload is not used by Qwen3.5`。
